Someone found a way into the cellars under the health resort. This is not a good set of circumstances for Tarkov. You may not have yet met the wardens who watch the city at night. But they certainly have met you. And now I need you to leave a short message for them at the Knossos facility, with their instruments. However, just dropping these knives in the rubble won't be enough. You need places with meaning, so that the knife you stick in becomes a symbol of sorts. Which places should you choose? You'll figure it out on your own.
